ArchitectProgress.title: ArchitectProgress
ArchitectProgress.description: Cloud-synced Academy progress, XP/Level state, completed modules, and unlocked trophies for an authenticated architect.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the document owner

architectName.description: Display name on the Architect Report Card

completedModules.description: Bounded list of completed module IDs (max 10)

completedScenarioIds.description: Bounded list of completed high-difficulty scenario IDs (max 10)

dailyTargetMinutes.description: Daily study goal target in minutes (10 to 240)

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of initial profile creation

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile update

DailyStudyGoal.title: DailyStudyGoal
DailyStudyGoal.description: Individual daily study goal item stored in a user subcollection.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the goal owner

titleFa.description: Persian title of the study goal

targetMinutes.description: Planned study duration in minutes (5 to 180)

completed.description: Whether the study goal has been completed

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when goal was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when goal was updated

/users/{userId}.description: Stores each authenticated architect's cloud-synced Academy progress, XP/Level telemetry, and report card metadata.

/users/{userId}/goals/{goalId}.description: Subcollection storing individual Daily Study Planner goals belonging to the parent user.
